question: What readonly/writeonly types feature was introduced in the TypeScript SDK on September 15, 2025?
ground_truth:
The September 15, 2025 TypeScript SDK release included:
- Version 2.11.1: Fixed _getAuthorizationHeader method to return Promise<string | undefined> when oauth is enabled to prevent compilation errors.
- Version 2.11.0: Added generation of Request and Response type variations for types with readonly and/or writeonly properties. For example, User type will have User.Request omitting readonly properties and User.Response omitting writeonly properties. Enable with experimentalGenerateReadWriteOnlyTypes: true in generator config.
